title: Survival ratio equals the uniform survival probability
statement: Let $s$ be a state of the contraction process, consisting of a multigraph $G$ together with a distinguished cut $C$ of $G$. Form the survival ratio by enumerating the edge occurrences of $G$ — the pairs of an edge with an index distinguishing its parallel copies — and dividing the number of occurrences whose underlying edge does not cross $C$ by the total number of occurrences. Then this ratio equals the uniform survival probability of $s$, namely the number of edges of $G$ that do not cross $C$, counted with multiplicity, divided by the total edge count of $G$.
hypotheses_covered: s is a state (a multigraph G with a distinguished cut C)
replaced:
For every state, the occurrence-space survival ratio coincides with the uniform survival
probability.
